evidence.tracked_count: Beds and the bus board; Table is a fixed countdown (17 minus the night) so it was treated as the clock; Struck is a report. Arguably 3 if Table is counted.
evidence.rival_tell: Assessor cycle (2 richest, 1 haunt, 1 home) inferred from strike texts: night 1 home, night 2 haunt (Layer 1), so nights 3 and 4 were rich; recess broke the pattern once.
evidence.ending_shape: Beds peaked at 16 on turn 9, then bled to 6 under dry wells and three more Assessor hits; two stalls on turn 15 sealed it, with the goal out of reach before the last night.
evidence.decision_unit: Nine of sixteen turns were bus-to-layer assignments; the rest were one shore, one sink and five holds.
evidence.player_frame: Dispatching a three-bus fleet is running a small organization, so manager rather than operator.
